content.short: Vault curator from Edge Capital running market-neutral strategies across CeFi and DeFi.
content.description: UltraYield packages the strategies of hedge fund Edge Capital into on-chain vaults for USD, BTC and ETH. Most rely on funding-rate arbitrage between centralized and decentralized exchanges, with little or no DeFi exposure, and the team curates vaults for partners such as Midas. It runs eight active vaults with around $58 million under strategy, and reports a 15% rolling 12-month return on its USD vaults.
